tasks.label: Build OpenMCP After Z.ai Master Session Support
Open Requested Master Sessions via OpenMCP
args: import { enableConfigs } from './src/utils/config.ts'; import { createMasterSessionSource, listMasterSessionSources } from './src/services/webRelay/session/MasterSessionRegistry.ts'; import { openMasterSessionSource } from './src/services/webRelay/session/MasterSessionController.ts'; enableConfigs(); const all=listMasterSessionSources(); const chatgpt=all.find(s=>s.id==='loco-verde'); const claude=all.find(s=>s.id==='locoverdesito'); if(!chatgpt||chatgpt.platformId!=='chatgpt') throw new Error('Expected existing ChatGPT source loco-verde.'); if(!claude||claude.platformId!=='claude') throw new Error('Expected existing Claude source locoverdesito.'); let zai=listMasterSessionSources().find(s=>s.name.toLowerCase()==='z.ai glm 5.3'); if(!zai) zai=createMasterSessionSource('Z.ai GLM 5.3','zai'); if(zai.platformId!=='zai') throw new Error('The Z.ai source name is already bound to another platform.'); for(const s of [chatgpt,claude,zai]){try{const r=await openMasterSessionSource(s.id); console.log(JSON.stringify({id:s.id,name:s.name,platform:s.platformId,port:r.debugPort,authenticated:r.authenticated,opened:true}));}catch(e){console.error(JSON.stringify({id:s.id,name:s.name,platform:s.platformId,port:s.debugPort,opened:false,error:e instanceof Error?e.message:String(e)}));}}
